title: Agent blob store: delete unreferenced blobs and add a quota
description: mimid-agent-jmap's BlobStore (<state_dir>/blobs) never deletes: uploads never used in a Message, and the blobs of destroyed Messages, stay on disk, and there is no quota. RFC 8620 §6 says unreferenced blobs SHOULD have a separate quota and MUST be deleted oldest first when an upload would exceed it, and MUST NOT be deleted within 1 hour of upload. Needs: a reference scan over stored Messages (persist.rs snapshot), mtime-based expiry for unreferenced blobs, and a quota constant (INVENTED).
close_reason: Commit e5d361d on branch blob-limits (not merged): unreferenced-blob quota per decision mimid-1wgh.68.
